# The Far Cove Stair

*Gorm is behind on the far cove stair. Clear 60 Shore Crabs off the Saltface below it, then ask Hamish to haul Gorm's cut stone up in his lift.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Goa Harbour](../towns/goa_harbour_quests.md) |
| Category | Side |
| Given by | [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md) |
| Level | 34 |
| Leads to | [The Last Flights](../quests/gorm_the_last_flights.md) |

## Objectives

1. Defeat 60 [Shore Crab](../monsters/shore_crab.md) in [The Saltface](../maps/saltface.md)
2. Talk to [Hamish](../npcs/hamish_lift.md)

## Rewards

- 8,000 EXP
- 1,400 mesos
- [Steamed Crab](../items/steamed_crab.md) x10
- +20 standing with Goa Harbour
- +150 standing with [Gorm](../npcs/gorm_stairs.md)
